name: AA Health Calculator
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
AA Health Calculator is a fast, easy-to-use tool that helps you track and improve your health with accurate insights.

Features

  1. Lightweight and mobile-friendly Best BMI calculator
  2. Multilingual support with translation-ready text domain
  3. Easy shortcode: `[aa-health-calculator]` to embed calculator anywhere
  4. Premium options configurable from admin panel
  5. Display BMI categories, ideal weight range, and health tips
  6. Modern, elegant, and responsive design
  7. Share BMI results on Twitter
  8. Email BMI report directly from the calculator
  9. Download BMI report as PDF file
  10. Admin shortcode generator for easy usage

How to use it

  1. Install and activate the AA Health Calculator plugin in WordPress.
  2. Go to the admin panel to configure premium options if needed.
  3. Insert the shortcode `[aa-health-calculator]` into any post, page, or widget.
  4. Visitors enter their weight (kg) and height (cm) in the calculator form.
  5. Click the “Calculate BMI” button to see their BMI and health info.
  6. Use options to share, email, or download the BMI report as PDF.

Installation

  1. Download the AA Health Calculator plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin after installation completes.
  6. Configure settings under Settings > AA Health Calculator if needed.

Changelog

  1. Version 1.0.1 (2025-06-02)
    1. Improved security, performance optimizations, and code cleanup.
    2. Fixed minor bugs and enhanced compatibility with latest WordPress versions.
    3. Added sharing, email, and PDF download functionality for BMI reports.
    4. Improved user experience with better mobile responsiveness.
    5. Enhanced UI with modern responsive design and mobile readiness.
    6. Refined layout and typography for better readability.
    7. Introduced premium options: health tips, ideal weight, and BMI categories.
    8. Added settings to enable/disable premium features in admin panel.
    9. Added multilingual support and translation readiness with text domain `aa-health-calculator`.
    10. Implemented shortcode generator in admin for easy shortcode insertion.
    11. Initial release with BMI calculation and basic features.
    12. Basic shortcode `[aa-health]` to embed calculator anywhere.
